old: Attacker chooses up to board-force warbands worth of attack dice. Defense shields multiplied by each double (x2,x4,...), plus warbands at targeted sites and defender board if pawn at attacker or targeted site; bandits one per targeted site. Attack skulls kill own force immediately; paired hollow swords count one, lone hollow zero. Attack must strictly exceed defense; may sacrifice force warbands +1 each, exactly enough to win, no excess; if unable/decline defender wins.
new: The attacker may collect attack dice up to the number of warbands in their attacking force (normally those on their board), after accounting for any applicable power that changes that force. Then apply the appropriate dice modifiers. Defense shields multiplied by each double (x2,x4,...), plus warbands at targeted sites and defender board if pawn at attacker or targeted site; bandits one per targeted site. Attack skulls kill own force immediately; paired hollow swords count one, lone hollow zero. Attack must strictly exceed defense; may sacrifice force warbands +1 each, exactly enough to win, no excess; if unable/decline defender wins.
reason: Errata5.5.2 deliberately replaces the board count with FORCE; board-only wording can misstate the ceiling when a power changes the attacking force.

source_references.text: Edit the last sentence to end with “in their FORCE (on their board).” (This just helps with interpretation of powers like Captains.)
The attacker adds attack dice to their attack pool up to the number of warbands on their board.

source_references.relevance: Explicitly recognizes an attacking force expanded by applicable card powers; this review does not require recalling an isolated power.
